title: Don’t offload the app
text: I’m aware that without a login you cannot save docs to a cloud but they can be stored locally as long as the app is not deleted. Offloaded the app for an iOS update and when put back on the phone, 9 years of documents gone. Did a system backup and docs still gone. They nor Apple can explain what happened. Just be aware beforehand of what could happen.

title: Great on the go.
